rail_filter.rule: a sample is a rail glitch when F1: sp.minion_w[0] > max(sp.minion_w[0] at i-2, at i+2) + 4.0 W (E82 A2's dip rule mirrored; E145's post-hoc definition) or F2: sp.minion_w[0] == sp.minion_w[2] (the running maximum the sample reports); glitch samples are removed whole, with the board's dips, before the reduction reads the telemetry
rail_filter.reads: the telemetry samples only, one block at a time; never an item, run, step, price or contrast

test_on_e145.equals_e145_posthoc: the union is E145's 15 post-hoc spikes; E145's reducer with it reproduces posthoc/runs-posthoc.csv and e145-posthoc.json byte for byte (e145_under_filter.py)

card0_prices_rail_fJ.what: card 0's earlier sessions (E130's 6 and E138's 9 B blocks, E130's 4 A blocks), equal to predictions-e145.json's frozen card0_prices_rail_fJ

card1_prices_rail_fJ_filtered.what: aifoundry1 card 1 (E145's 13 B and 3 A blocks) under E151's rail filter

precision.from: the per-block B odd - even on the rail (rail fJ) of E138's 9, E130's 6 and E145's 13 (filtered) B blocks
precision.what: half-width = t(0.975, n - 1) x sd / c_rb / sqrt(n), board-equivalent fJ; R1 reads RECODED only if the mean is at least T_B + half-width

expected.E151-R4: INCONCLUSIVE between BOOTH ON B / NO BOOTH
expected.blocks: 10 B and 1 A (the budget rule decides; 9 B and 1 A if the blocks run slow)
expected.cross_session_card0: per position < parity < flat in rms; per position about 3-5 rail fJ (7-10%), flat about 13-14 (about 29%)
expected.cross_card_from_card1_filtered: per position < parity < flat; per position about 3-5 rail fJ (7-10%), flat about 13-15 (30-35%)
expected.why: card 0's sessions read +33.15 (E130) and +35.95 (E138) board-equivalent fJ; at 10 kept B blocks and E138's block sd (5.77 rail fJ) the half-width is about 5.1, so RECODED needs a mean of at least 35.8: the simulated chance is about 0.3-0.5 at card 0's means (precision.simulated_chances), and about 0.9 or more if the scatter is E130's (2.77). FLAT is near impossible. The rail on this card has shown no glitch in about 700,000 samples, so the filter is expected to remove nothing. One A block is too few to score the control (E145's minimum is 3); R6 as card 0's rail (E138's b2_7 / b1_7 = 0.69).
